exposure: Operative vaginal deliveries ≥ 34 weeks of gestation
outcome: Injury to scalp due to birth trauma
cohort: 171,698 women with singleton deliveries ≥ 23 weeks of gestation in the USA between 2002 and 2008
finding: Fetal scalp electrode use during labor was associated with a small increased risk of neonatal scalp injury and cephalohaematoma, although the absolute risk remained low.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in neonatal complications when comparing the use of fetal scalp electrodes during operative vaginal deliveries (vacuum or forceps-assisted) to operative vaginal deliveries alone.
